says: The founder founds Team A for review with Bora as reviewer; Bora accepts the exact founding request and it commits, admitting the founder by founding and Bora by nomination with a grant for each. Under Team A the founder registers a source home (source.home.register), commits a revision to it (source.revision.commit) and sets that source's own rights to allow read, use and derive (source.rights.set), each commit expecting the source head the one before it moved to. The founder then founds a new Team by derivation (team.found, self-founded, with derived_from naming Team A and selecting exactly two things: the source's stored revision and Team A's policy as its settings). The proposal carries its own new team_id. The owner commits the copy under its own head with its own sealed proposal and policy, the founder's membership by the copy's own founding, one grant for the founder, an active state, a profile named Platform copy and its own founding epoch. A team.state.read of the copy returns exactly those: no membership or grant for Bora, no approval, no credential and none of Team A's history. A read of Team A at its head still returns Team A's two memberships, two grants and state, so the derivation did not change the original.
